lessons.title: Week 1 Part 1: Understanding Child Safety & Developmental Needs
lessons.content: In Week 1 of Child Protection Awareness & Protective Care, this lesson focuses on understanding child safety & developmental needs. Parents and carers practise pausing to notice stress cues, responding with calm and predictable language, maintaining child-safe boundaries, and recording one observable example of how this skill supported their child's safety and emotional wellbeing this week.
